game.title: Pico-Clinic
title.subtitle: The drone micro-surgery workshop
op.hint.unscrew: Put your finger on a screw, then circle around it to unscrew it.
op.hint.rusty: Rusty screw: keep turning a little longer!
op.hint.connector: The connector is unplugged. Drag the plug to its socket.
done.title: Fixed!
op.hint.chip_remove: The chip is fried! Grab it and pull it off the green board.
op.hint.chip_drag_old: Take it off the green board, then let go.
op.hint.chip_place: Take the new chip from the box at the top right and set it on the frame.
op.hint.chip_drag_new: Aim for the frame: let go when it turns bright white.
op.hint.solder: The track is cut. Put your finger on the orange ring, on the iron's handle: the tip stays ahead of your finger.
op.hint.heating: The iron is heating up… hold still!
op.hint.trace: Follow the path to the other pad without lifting your finger.
op.chip_off_board: Take it all the way off the board!
op.chip_miss: Not quite… aim for the frame.
op.too_early: Wait for the iron to heat up!
op.break: Finger lifted: start again from the pad.
op.hint.diag: Diagnosis! Put your finger on the board: a magnifier appears. Move it around to find hidden faults.
op.hint.diag_move: Move the magnifier over the parts of the board.
op.hint.vacuum: The vacuum follows your finger, just above it. Rub quickly and avoid the circled capacitors!
op.hint.rust_left: Still some rust: rub it with your finger to vacuum it, or press Start.
op.fragile_broken: Ouch! Broken capacitor: you'll have to buy a new one.
done.already_paid: Order already paid: replay for 3 stars!
op.hint.rust: Rust (brown spots)! Rub it quickly with your finger: the vacuum appears just above it. Avoid the blue capacitors.
op.hint.cap_remove: A capacitor is broken: the drone won't start. Grab it and take it off the board.
op.hint.cap_place: Take a new capacitor (next to the box) and put it on a blinking spot.
op.hint.cap_drag_new: Drop it on the blinking spot.
op.cap_miss: Not quite… aim for the spot.
op.hint.cap_drag_old: Take it off the green board, then let go.
orders.title: Orders
orders.need_stars: Exam: you need {n} stars (you have {s}). Replay some orders!
shop.title: Shop
tool.laser.desc: Very wide path, burns even more slowly
tool.vacuum_pump.desc: Cleans an area twice as wide
tool.scanner.desc: Shows every fault as soon as you open up
tool.tweezers_fine.desc: Chips and capacitors snap in more easily
done.need_stars: Next order: exam at {n} stars (you have {s})
arc.lea.1.intro: Hello... my drone won't work. Dad says it's too old.
arc.lea.1.thanks: It flies! Thank you so much!
arc.passage.2.intro: My drone spent the winter at the back of the garage. Look at all this rust!
arc.passage.3.intro: My dog chewed a cable. Since then it won't fly at all.
arc.passage.3.thanks: It flies! I'll keep it on a higher shelf, promise.
arc.passage.4.intro: It went "pfff" and a little smoke came out. It smells burnt!
arc.passage.4.thanks: No more burnt smell! It's like magic.
arc.passage.5.intro: It won't start and I can't see anything broken. Can you take a look?
arc.passage.5.thanks: Two hidden faults? Good thing you have a magnifier!
arc.passage.6.intro: My dragonfly fell into a puddle. She creaks when she flaps her wings.
arc.passage.6.thanks: She's twirling! Thank you, thank you!
arc.volute.7.intro: My scarab Auguste, a darling! His wing cases have been dragging for a week.
arc.volute.7.thanks: Auguste is flying! You have fairy fingers. I'll be back, you can count on me.
arc.turbo.8.intro: Ten minutes before the race! Can you do it in five?
arc.turbo.8.thanks: You're the best! I owe you a win.
arc.lea.9.intro: This is Pantoufle. Grandma gave him to me. He doesn't purr anymore.
arc.ampere.10.intro: I... built this. I think. I lost the plans.
arc.ampere.10.thanks: Extraordinary! How did you guess? You remind me of someone.
counter.title: Counter
counter.exam_line: Rank {r} exam, boss! Every star counts here. Even one is enough to pass.
orders.gribouille_stars: To open the exam we need {n} stars, boss. We have {s}. Let's replay old orders to earn the missing ones!
nb.title: Master Ohm's notebook
nb.parts_hint: Never sold: they must be earned.
nb.use.proto: Needed for the prototype of order {n}
rank.1.unlocks: Simple toy drones, screwdriver and basic iron
rank.2.unlocks: Cyber insects, strong vacuum, precision iron, Pantoufle
rank.3.unlocks: Mechanical mascots, thermal magnifier, fine tweezers
rank.4.unlocks: Pro and race drones, laser, magnetic pump, antistatic tweezers
client.lea.bio: A shy little girl. Her robot plush Pantoufle was made by her grandmother.
client.volute.bio: A chatty collector of mechanical insects. She names every one of them and is preparing a big exhibition.
client.turbo.bio: A drone racer, hasty and boastful, but a good loser. His rival is called Zephyr.
client.ampere.bio: An absent-minded inventor who always loses his plans. He seems to have known Master Ohm...
client.brindille.bio: An overworked neighborhood courier. His little drone fleet breaks down every week.
client.quartz.bio: The serious, demanding director of a large robot clinic.
rankup.title: New rank!
rankup.gribouille: Well done, boss! The workshop is growing. Master Ohm would be proud.
op.hint.lift: No more screws! Slide the cover upward to remove it.
gribouille.hint1: Draw a circle around the screw.
tuto.o01: Our very first client! Don't worry, boss: I'll show you everything.
tuto.o08: With Turbo, every second counts: finish before the target time for a big tip!
tuto.open: Tap the drone to put it under the lamp.
tuto.click: Click! The screw is out. Nice job!
tuto.screws: Now do the same with the other three screws.
tuto.cover: No more screws! Slide the cover upward.
tuto.connector: See the blinking plug? Slide it into its socket.
tuto.start: All fixed! Press Start to close it up.
tuto.lever: The magic moment: pull the lever down!
tuto.stars: Three stars to earn: it works, it's clean, and your repair is precise.
tuto.credits: The client pays you in credits. If you're quick, they add a tip!
tuto.shop: Credits buy better tools. Let's go see the shop!
tuto.shop_here: This is Master Ohm's shop. Every tool has three levels.
tuto.shop_here2: A better iron, a stronger lens... Come back when you have credits. Back to work!
tuto.rusty: This screw is rusty: you'll have to turn longer. Keep going!
tuto.vacuum: Rust! Rub over it quickly: the vacuum follows your finger, just above it.
tuto.vacuum2: Keep going! Avoid the blue capacitors, they're fragile.
tuto.solder: A cut trace! Grab the iron by the orange ring, wait for it to heat, then follow the trace.
tuto.chip_out: Something smells burnt! Grab the smoking chip and pull it off the green board.
tuto.chip_in: Now take a new chip from the box and set it in the frame.
tuto.diag: Can't see anything? Keep your finger down: a magnifier appears. Move it over the board.
tuto.diag2: Slowly... Stop on each part to look at it closely.
tuto.diag_done: Found it! Hidden faults don't stand a chance against you.
tuto.curve: A trace with a bend! Follow the curve carefully, no rushing.
chapter.1.title: The Inheritance
chapter.1.sub: The first clients of Master Ohm's workshop
chapter.2.title: The Workshop Grows
chapter.2.sub: Turbo comes back, Mr. Brindille arrives
story.ch1.1: Oh! Hello! Sorry, I didn't hear you come in. I'm Gribouille.
story.ch1.2: Welcome to Master Ohm's workshop, the best drone repairer in the neighborhood.
story.ch1.3: He left one morning without a word. He left his tools, me... and a key with your name on it.
story.ch1.4: So, boss, shall we reopen the workshop? Look, here's someone already!
story.nb.1: Boss! Look what I found stuck under the workbench: Master Ohm's notebook!
story.nb.2: He wrote everything in it: his clients, his ranks, the rare parts he collected.
story.nb.3: Now it's your notebook. You'll find it next to the shop, in the order list.
story.nb.page: A good repairer listens to the machine before touching it. — O.
story.ch2.1: Boss, did you see? The whole neighborhood is talking about the workshop!
story.ch2.2: Turbo swears he'll never race again without stopping by. He says you're his lucky charm.
story.ch2.3: And a courier, Mr. Brindille, left three messages this morning. His fleet is worn out.
story.ch2.4: New patients are coming too: dragonflies, beetles, plushies... This is going to be a workout!
arc.brindille.11.intro: Another courier out of service. The round won't wait!
arc.brindille.11.thanks: Perfect. See you next week! Well, I hope not.
arc.passage.12.intro: My dragonfly has been flying in circles since this morning. She looks dizzy.
arc.passage.12.thanks: She's flying straight! Well, straight for a dragonfly.
arc.passage.13.intro: My beetle goes clack-clack when it walks. My cat won't go near it.
arc.passage.13.thanks: No more clack-clack! The cat is relieved, and so am I.
arc.brindille.14.intro: My drone keeps delivering next to the mailbox. It's out of tune, isn't it?
arc.brindille.14.thanks: It aims true now! My neighbor will finally get her parcels.
arc.turbo.15.intro: Qualifiers tomorrow. Zephyr brags that he has the fastest drone in town.
arc.turbo.15.thanks: It's faster than before! Zephyr had better watch out.
arc.volute.16.intro: My dragonfly Cleo has lost her sparkle. I found her in Lisbon in 1998, imagine!
arc.volute.16.thanks: There she shines! I'll tell all my friends.
arc.passage.17.intro: It's my son's plush toy. It went for a spin in the washing machine...
arc.passage.17.thanks: All clean and working again! My son will jump for joy.
arc.lea.18.intro: Pantoufle got cold by the window yesterday. He's making a funny noise.
arc.lea.18.thanks: No more noise! I gave him a scarf.
arc.brindille.19.intro: It swelled up all at once, like a balloon. I thought I'd bring it before it blew.
arc.brindille.19.thanks: Phew, no explosion! I'll buy you a coffee... some other day.
arc.passage.20.intro: I found it in the attic, all rusty. It was my grandfather's beetle.
arc.passage.20.thanks: Good as new! Grandpa would be proud of him.
arc.ampere.21.intro: My drone doesn't fly straight anymore. There was a plan somewhere, in another pocket.
arc.ampere.21.thanks: It flies straight! A man used to do the same, with those same moves.
arc.volute.22.intro: My two jewels, Cleo and Auguste, before my exhibition. Everything must be perfect.
arc.volute.22.thanks: Perfect! You are officially the repairer of my collection.
back.title: Leave this repair?
back.text: The patient goes back to the order list. What you've already fixed will be lost.
